about: Questions players ask Nexo about a game, in pt-BR, and what a passage that answers them must contain. `terms` are the English trophy names nexo.mentioned_trophies finds when the question names a trophy by its pt-BR (or English) name. A retrieved passage is relevant when its heading plus content contains every keyword of at least one group in `relevant` (case-insensitive).
